name: Kinetic Pin (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic blast class feature, Improved Grapple.

Benefit(s): Whenever you would deal damage with a grapple check, you can deal 1/2 of your simple kinetic blast damage instead, allowing a Reflex save at your blast’s DC for 1/4 damage. You can choose which of your simple blasts you use to determine the damage and its type.
